import os, sys, torch, copy
import torch.distributed as dist
import torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, "/tmp/obench-cell-m2_wyowt/bench_opencode_torch-pipeline-parallelism_8dn8r3i5")
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(port))
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5,
                      num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2, max_position_embeddings=64)
    dtype=torch.float32; dev=torch.device("cpu")
    ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).to(dtype); model = copy.deepcopy(ref)
    ins = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]; tg = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
    for i,t in zip(ins,tg):
        l = ref(i).logits; (F.cross_entropy(l.reshape(-1,100), t.reshape(-1))/3).backward()
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, ins, tg, dev, dtype)
    md=0; n=0
    for (nm,p),(_,q) in zip(ref.named_parameters(), model.named_parameters()):
        if q.grad is not None:
            n+=1; md=max(md,(p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(f"ws={ws} rank={rank} loss={loss} params_with_grad={n} maxdiff={md:.2e}")
    dist.destroy_process_group()

if __name__=="__main__":
    for ws,port in ((1,29511),(2,29512)):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,port), nprocs=ws)
